from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        shared_memory = operator.SharedMemory(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, num_rounds=2, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.CAESAR_SHARED_EXTRACT, prompt_custom.CAESAR_SHARED_MAP, prompt_custom.CAESAR_SHARED_CHECK], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.CAESAR_SHARED_AGGREGATOR_STRICT)
        draft = await shared_memory(problem)
        finalizer = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.aggregator_llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.CAESAR_FINAL_REDECRYPT_A, prompt_custom.CAESAR_FINAL_REDECRYPT_B, prompt_custom.CAESAR_FINAL_REDECRYPT_C], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.CAESAR_FINAL_VOTE_AGGREGATOR)
        solution = await finalizer(f"{problem}\n\nDraft answer from prior stage:\n{draft['response']}")
        worker_usage = self.llm.get_usage_delta()
        if self.aggregator_llm is self.llm:
            aggregator_usage = {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0}
        else:
            aggregator_usage = self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": worker_usage,
            "aggregator": aggregator_usage,
        }
